data.name: Iuliana
data.gender_notes: Iuliana is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Iulianus, meaning 'downy-haired, youthful' or 'from Jupiter'. The feminine form is Iuliana, which translates to 'youthful, soft' in Latin. The name Iuliana carries the meaning “Youthful, Downy, Soft” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Iuliana usually hope their child will grow to embody youthful, downy, soft and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Iuliana is a name with a rich spiritual history. It is derived from the Latin name Iulianus, which means 'downy-haired, youthful'. In Roman mythology, Jupiter was the king of the gods, and the name Iulianus was believed to bring the blessings of Jupiter upon the bearer. Iuliana is a name that evokes grace, beauty, and a connection to the divine.
data.etymology: Iuliana belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Youthful, Downy, Soft.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iuliana total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: יוליאנה
in_hebrew.meaning: המשמעות היא: חסידה, קדושה, אמונה, ובכבוד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יוליאנה היא שם נשים שמוצאו ביוונית, ומשמעותו: חסידה, קדושה, אמונה, ובכבוד. השם נקשר לקדושה יוליאנה הקדושה, אחת מהקדושות המוכרות ביותר בנצרות. השם נכנס לעברית דרך היוונית, והוא נפוץ בעיקר בקרב קהילות הנצרות המזרחית. בעברית, השם נכתב: יוליאנה, ומשמעותו: חסידה, קדושה, אמונה, ובכבוד. השם נחשב לשם נשים הנוקשר למידות טובות, כמו: אמונה, קדושה, ובכבוד.

in_greek.name: Ιουλιανή
in_greek.meaning: η σημασία είναι: ευσεβής, αγία, πίστη, και σεβασμός
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Ιουλιανή είναι ένα γυναικείο όνομα που προέρχεται από τη λατινική γλώσσα και σημαίνει: ευσεβής, αγία, πίστη, και σεβασμός. Το όνομα συνδέεται με την Αγία Ιουλιανή, μια από τις πιο γνωστές αγίες της Ορθοδοξίας. Το όνομα εισήχθη στην ελληνική γλώσσα από τη λατινική γλώσσα και είναι δημοφιλές κυρίως μεταξύ των ορθοδόξων χριστιανών. Στην ελληνική γλώσσα, το όνομα γράφεται: Ιουλιανή, και σημαίνει: ευσεβής, αγία, πίστη, και σεβασμός. Το όνομα θεωρείται όνομα γυναικών που συνδέεται με τις καλές προσωπικότητες, όπως: πίστη, αγία, και σεβασμός.

in_latin.name: Iuliana
in_latin.meaning: significat: pia, sancta, fides, et reverentia
in_latin.long_meaning: Iuliana est nomen femininum quod oriundum est ex lingua Latina et significat: pia, sancta, fides, et reverentia. Nomen illi attribuitur Sancta Iuliana, una ex sanctis catholicae Ecclesiae. Nomen Latinum introductum in linguam Latinam et est popularis in Ecclesia Catholica. In lingua Latina, nomen scribitur: Iuliana, et significat: pia, sancta, fides, et reverentia. Nomen est nomen femininum quod attribuitur bonis moribus, ut: fides, sanctitas, et reverentia.

in_english.name: Iuliana
in_english.meaning: meaning: pious, saintly, faith, and reverence
in_english.long_meaning: Iuliana is a feminine given name of Latin origin, meaning: pious, saintly, faith, and reverence. The name is associated with Saint Iuliana, one of the most revered saints in Christianity. The name entered the English language through Latin and is popular mainly among Catholics. In English, the name is spelled: Iuliana, and means: pious, saintly, faith, and reverence. The name is considered a feminine given name that is associated with good qualities, such as: faith, saintliness, and reverence.
